dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: Hello there. Do tell — what can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Court of Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: Is this your first time here? If it is, let me recommend some hot spots to you.

dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: If you're interested in the news and want to know more about Fontaine, I recommend you head in the direction of The Steambird.

dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: If you wish, you can purchase a copy of The Steambird along the way, and if you're lucky, you might even stumble upon the scene of a journalist conducting an interview.

dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: If you're interested in the latest fashion, you can check out Damoville Purveyor in Quartier Narbonnais.

dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: Perfume and clothing stores that push the times and tides here in Fontaine can be found there, too. Many tourists fresh off the boat make Narbonnais their first stop, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: The Callas Line heads northward, toward the Fontaine Research Institute. The Navia Line heads to Erinnyes in the east, and the Clementine Line, the Romaritime Harbor in the south.

dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: The Melusine tour guides on board will introduce you to the unique sights of our land, so stay tuned.

dialogues.speaker: Sylvie
dialogues.text: It was my pleasure to serve you. May we meet again!
